description: A monthly gridded burned area database of national wildland fire data is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Gincheva, Andrina et al. We assembled the first gridded burned area (BA) database of national wildfire data (ONFIRE), an integrated resource for researchers, non-government organisations, and government agencies analysing wildfires in various regions of the Earth. Coverage: Australia, Canada, Chile, Europe and the United States. Formats: NetCDF, TXT. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
